name: Rubescent-Pingo
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a subterranean ocean, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
